links.outcome: Feasibility of a prospective single-center AI handheld echo pilot with real users
links.effect: 206 of 287 attempts (71.8%) were analyzable. The study does not establish safety, diagnostic accuracy versus comprehensive echocardiography, or an independent effect of AI.
links.quote: A governed AI-enabled HUD pathway was feasible in a tertiary hospital and provided interpretable studies in 71.8% of attempts.

unlisted_practices: Structured two-month echocardiography training curriculum for non-certified physicians using AI-assisted handheld ultrasound
Centralized expert review, remote review, and quality assurance of handheld echo images archived in the EMR

screen.reason: Prospective clinical implementation study evaluating AI-assisted handheld ultrasound paired with structured staff training, EHR integration, and centralized expert governance/remote review.

primary.practice: structured training curriculum and expert governance with remote review
